svg.title: Autolysosome — Section
svg.desc: Original schematic autolysosome with one outer limiting membrane, heterogeneous partially degraded cargo and open internal membrane remnants. It is distinguished from an autophagosome by its single outer membrane; marks do not quantify degradation or activity.
